newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - September 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - September 9.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Monday's Daily Variety:

* HOLLYWOOD - NBC's "E.R." lost the battle, but ultimately won the war at Sunday night's 48th Annual Primetime Emmy Awards, claiming the award for top drama. The televison show had been nominated for 17 awards.
* HOLLYWOOD - Peter Roth, who has served as president of 20th Century Fox Television for two years, will assume the post of president at News Corp's Fox Entertainment Group, replacing John Matoian.
* HOLLYWOOD - Sharon Stone has signed with Creative Artists Agency after two years without an agent.
* PARIS - France's giant Canal Plus strengthened its position as a dominant force in European pay television Friday's announcement that it bought the Dutch pay TV group NetHold.
